services.desc: “I can’t believe the difference.” Our amazing Little Champs Kids Martial Arts Program is offering classes here in Toronto! Martial arts is not just self-defense. It’s a tool we use to help kids become leaders. Hundreds of Toronto parents can’t believe the incredible transformation. We don’t have many rules here, but they’re very rigorously enforced. As a result, kids learn and develop strong, healthy boundaries. And boundaries are so essential to helping kids thrive. Discipline and respect flourish within a few short weeks. services.name: Summer Camp in Toronto
services.desc: Every day features martial arts classes that concentrate on enhancing basic martial arts skills (no experience necessary), drills, and developing some of the more intricate techniques in our curriculum. Campers will also play games, do crafts and go on local outings. Your child will learn the importance of teamwork, confidence and self-discipline through our activities both in and out of our dojang. Campers bring lunch and snacks each day but on Friday, campers will get a pizza lunch. For thousands of years, martial arts has taught kids Discipline, Focus, Respect, and Confidence. blurb: Whether you’re 3 or 73 (or anywhere in between) looking for fitness, fun, discipline, or self-defense, we have a spot for you at DeSantos Martial Arts! All instructors at DeSantos Martial Arts are students of our grand master, “Kwan Jan Nim” Veronica DeSantos, one of Canada’s most respected martial arts masters, who opened the school in 1988!
